nodes.name: restore-gemini-plan

parameters.jsCode:
// A mid-article quota failure restarts every chunk in Gemini to avoid mixed audio formats.
return $('Plan Audio').all().map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, fallbackFromQwen: true }, pairedItem: item.pairedItem }));

nodes.notes: Why Code: restores all Plan Audio chunks after quota exhaustion so Gemini regenerates a complete, format-consistent article.

const current = $('chunk-loop').first().json;
return [{ json: { ...current, ...$input.first().json } }];

const plan = $('restore-cached-plan').item.json;
return { json: { ...plan }, binary: $input.item.binary };

const plan = $('restore-gemini-plan').item.json;
return { json: { ...plan, ...$input.item.json } };

nodeGroups.name: Read & plan
nodeGroups.description: Loads lexical content, versions narration and semantic chunk hashes, then decides whether audio work is needed.

nodeGroups.name: Write to Ghost
nodeGroups.description: Re-reads the post and inserts or updates the native audio card without overwriting concurrent edits.

nodeGroups.name: Generate audio
nodeGroups.description: Reuses semantic chunks, restores metadata across HTTP nodes, synthesizes missing audio and publishes ordered audio with cue manifest.

activeVersion.name: Skip TTS for non-public posts
activeVersion.description: Security fix F1: Plan Audio now returns no items unless post.visibility is 'public', so members-only, paid and tier posts are never narrated, uploaded to the public CDN, or given an audio card above the paywall.
